rows: Students who like biology, chemistry, products, regulation, and healthcare systems more than direct patient diagnosis.
One of the more scalable PCB routes, a pharmacy, distribution, or product business can grow well beyond what a single person can do alone, unlike a fixed clinical salary.
Students who like movement, recovery, hands-on care, and long-term patient progress.
A strong route when you like practical healing and rehab more than diagnosis-heavy clinical medicine, and one where an established therapist can build or expand their own practice.
Students who want a clinical healthcare route with focused patient work instead of broad medicine.
Still a real doctor-route decision. It needs clarity about the work, not just a fallback mindset after MBBS, though dentistry does carry real private-practice upside over time.
Nursing, patient care, and allied health
Students who can handle people, systems, urgency, and practical care work with consistency.
This is serious healthcare work, not a 'lesser' option. It fits students who want real care responsibility, though growth is more salary-capped than ownership-driven.

items.heading: Ask What the Real Daily
items.text: Ask what the real daily work looks like. If nobody can describe the actual work beyond 'doctor' or 'healthcare,' the family is still choosing a title, not a life path.

items.heading: Ask Whether the Student Truly
items.text: Ask whether the student truly wants hospitals, patients, or care responsibility. Biology marks do not automatically equal clinical fit. The emotional and practical reality matters too.

items.heading: Ask What the Full Cost
items.text: Ask what the full cost and time runway looks like. Exams, coaching, college fees, and delayed income all matter. Respect the total investment, not just the prestige word.

items.heading: Ask How Proof and Backup
items.text: Ask how proof and backup planning will happen. A serious plan should include real testing, visible effort, and a parallel route in case one narrow target does not work out.
